text: Submit a compelling "Prototype Fund" application in October
description: Use October to turn the Prototype Fund opportunity into a submitted-quality application early in the 1 October-30 November window. Target an internal complete draft by 15 October and submission by 31 October, leaving November for corrections if the platform permits. Frame the funded project as a concrete new open-source software-infrastructure module, not as general operating support for an already-built application.

status.comment: The October application objective depends on Felix’s eligibility confirmation, final approval, and institutional submission; preparation can resume when those inputs and the application window are available.

reflection: Status reconciliation on 2026-07-30 propagated the explicit human gate from the Prototype Fund application child. The objective is scheduled for October and requires human legal/eligibility representations and submission authority, so it is not currently actionable autonomous work.
